description: For git KBs: pull upstream changes and reindex. For local KBs: reindex files with newer modification times. On merge conflict: aborts merge and returns conflicted file list.
embedding_description: Refresh an already-installed knowledge base by pulling in newer source content. For git-backed KBs it runs a git pull of upstream commits and then reindexes; for local KBs it reindexes only files whose modification time is newer than the last index. Aborts and reports the conflicted files on a git merge conflict. Use to sync a KB with upstream changes or pick up locally edited files without rebuilding the whole index.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Updated KB name and changed file count
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: MergeConflictError: upstream changes conflict with local edits. GitError: fetch or pull failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Resolve conflicts via edit_file then retry update.
